summary: Iteration 2 — verified the Webhooks-icon compilation fix in DevPortal AND the new KYC/KYB Document upload feature backed by Emergent Object Storage. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases passed (upload PDF, list, download bytes, soft-delete, .exe rejection, .zip rejection, PNG upload, unauth rejection + 3 smoke regression tests for /auth/me, /organizations, /dashboard/overview). Frontend: /developers loads PUBLICLY (no auth needed), all 5 endpoint sidebar items (Authentication / Subscribe & Redeem / Mint / Webhooks / Transactions) update the right pane, language tabs (curl/javascript/python) switch the example code block. Portal /portal/organization renders the DocumentsPanel below the org info card with dropzone, browse btn, type-select dropdown, and shows the previously-uploaded file with Download + Delete buttons. Backoffice /app/clients/org_e0d081eab53d also renders the DocumentsPanel.

minor.issue: 403 multi-tenant rejection (non-internal user uploading to another org) was NOT exercised — the only available test session is super_admin/internal which bypasses the check. Code path inspected and looks correct, but no live integration test.

action_items: (Optional) Add a dedicated non-internal client user session to /app/memory/test_credentials.md so the 403 cross-org upload guard can be exercised end-to-end.
(Nit) DevPortal: when the language tab is changed, the example block updates but the heading/response don't — that's by design. No action.
critical_code_review_comments: storage.py uses synchronous `requests` inside async FastAPI handlers — for KYC files up to 10 MB this can block the event loop; consider httpx.AsyncClient or running put_object/get_object in a thread executor.

/api/documents/{id}/download declares unused `auth` (Query) and `authorization` (Header) parameters — these are dead-code, can be removed; auth is fully handled by the `Depends(get_current_user)` cookie/Bearer logic.
Allowed extensions checked only by filename — for stronger validation, also sniff magic bytes (e.g., %PDF, PNG header) before accepting.
routers.py is now ~1480 lines; please split into /backend/routers/*.py per domain (the empty package already exists).
DocumentsPanel.jsx: when delete fails the spinner state is fine, but the dropzone has no aria-label/role for screen readers — accessibility nit.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/conftest.py (token now reads PROSPER_TEST_TOKEN env, default updated to active token)

success_rate.frontend: 100% (dev portal public + portal docs panel + backoffice docs panel verified)
